findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/run-close.ts::run close's bracket spawns have no timeouts
findings.title: run close's bracket spawns have no timeouts
findings.disposition_rationale: These are the same subcommands the prose ran with no bound (reconcile, conclude, anchor-run, bundle publish, judge-trail, andon); the bounded-wait rule the invariant names is for forge and tracker waits. An arbitrary timeout could abort a legitimate bundle publish mid-write; only the status probe carries the spec's 30 s bound.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/run-open.ts::adopt's owner-status gate is checked outside the ledger lock
findings.title: adopt's owner-status gate is checked outside the ledger lock
findings.action: Re-check owner.status inside every locked edit.
findings.disposition_rationale: Every run open locked edit now refuses (exit 2) unless the fresh ledger's owner.status is running, so an abort or close landing after step 1 is never written over and an aborted-resumable owner is never set to done (test 'owner re-checked under the lock').

occurrences.title: adopt's owner-status gate is checked outside the ledger lock

findings.title: run close's run-end counts come from a pre-lock ledger read
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec orders run-end (step 3) before the locked close (step 4), and the orchestrator writes every outcome in-turn at steps 7 and 11 before it calls run close, so no concurrent outcome writer exists at close time.
